title: Review of membrane_evo L7: the biomass sweep replicates on seeds 21, 22, but it is carried by a few large K2 bodies and swings with single whole-cell flips (Weak)
summary: Ran membrane_evo_up, the identical-event twin membrane_evo and membrane_evo_down unchanged on fresh seeds 21 and 22 (T=40000, labkit, 161 frames). Final K2 biomass share (sum K2 / sum K1+K2 over the field): up 0.93 and 0.78, twin 0.46 and 0.30, down 0.00 and 0.00, so the claimed sign replicates. The sheet of up seed 21 shows how: from t~19000 one or two K2 cells (orange) become the largest, irregular bodies in the domain (high link yield makes bigger cells), and the share moves with them; at t~33000 those big cells are K1 again (a whole-cell flip back) before K2 returns. Up seed 22 fell to K2 share 0.00 at 3/4 of the run and recovered to 0.78. Walled cells from noise with a link ring (rim/core 1.47, 49/70 membrane-like) and 11 persistent splits, gen 3, on up seed 21. Death disks are visible (t=31250, 40000).

observations.B: membrane_evo_up/seed21/FACTS.md: L rim/core 1.47, rim/outside 4.35, 49/70 individually membrane-like
observations.D: membrane_evo_up/seed21/metrics.json: 11 persistent splits, max generation 3 (merges 11 / splits 45)
observations.H: k2_share.txt: final K2 biomass share up 0.93/0.78 vs twin 0.46/0.30 vs down 0.00/0.00 on seeds 21/22

seeds_run.result: sign replicates at the end (up 0.78, twin 0.30, down 0); up fell to 0 at 3/4 of the run

controls_run.H: membrane_evo/seed21, seed22 (identical-event twin, b2 = b) and membrane_evo_down/ (b2 < b)

verdicts.limitation: I measured only biomass share, not per-kind births and deaths. In the sheet the K2 share is carried by a few large, irregular K2 bodies, and whole-cell flips act in both directions on those big cells, so single flip events move the share by tens of percent (seed 22: 0.40 -> 0.00 -> 0.78). Biomass favours the high-yield kind directly because high yield makes larger cells, so the readout mixes body size with demographic success. Deaths are the imposed r=14 disks. With 2 seeds per arm and these swings, H is seen but not established.
